patients_age_check.name: patients_age_check
patients_age_check.value: "app"."patients"."stated_age_years" IS NULL OR ("app"."patients"."stated_age_years" BETWEEN 0 AND 130 AND "app"."patients"."stated_age_on" IS NOT NULL)

lab_documents_removed_check.name: lab_documents_removed_check
lab_documents_removed_check.value: ("app"."lab_documents"."removed_at" IS NULL) = ("app"."lab_documents"."removed_by" IS NULL) AND ("app"."lab_documents"."removed_at" IS NULL) = ("app"."lab_documents"."removed_reason" IS NULL)

sale_items_amount_check.name: sale_items_amount_check
sale_items_amount_check.value:
("app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."sold_as" = 'unit' AND "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."packs" IS NULL AND "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."amount" = "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."unit_price" * "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."quantity")
        OR ("app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."sold_as" = 'pack' AND "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."packs" > 0 AND "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."quantity" = "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."packs" * "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."pack_size" AND "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."amount" = "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."unit_price" * "app"."pharmacy_sale_items"."packs")

stock_count_lines_quantity_check.name: stock_count_lines_quantity_check
stock_count_lines_quantity_check.value: ("app"."stock_count_lines"."first_count" IS NULL OR "app"."stock_count_lines"."first_count" >= 0) AND ("app"."stock_count_lines"."recount" IS NULL OR "app"."stock_count_lines"."recount" >= 0)

stock_count_lines_snapshot_check.name: stock_count_lines_snapshot_check
stock_count_lines_snapshot_check.value: ("app"."stock_count_lines"."first_count" IS NULL) = ("app"."stock_count_lines"."first_system" IS NULL) AND ("app"."stock_count_lines"."recount" IS NULL) = ("app"."stock_count_lines"."recount_system" IS NULL)

sale_return_items_source_check.name: sale_return_items_source_check
sale_return_items_source_check.value: "app"."sale_return_items"."sale_item_id" IS NOT NULL OR "app"."sale_return_items"."gst_rate" IS NOT NULL

admission_charges_void_check.name: admission_charges_void_check
admission_charges_void_check.value: "app"."admission_charges"."voided_at" IS NULL OR "app"."admission_charges"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL

bed_stays_override_check.name: bed_stays_override_check
bed_stays_override_check.value: ("app"."bed_stays"."override_hours" IS NULL AND "app"."bed_stays"."override_rate" IS NULL) OR "app"."bed_stays"."override_reason" IS NOT NULL
